instructions:
You check one claim that a program made about a page of a document. Read the page text and answer the question with yes, no or cannotTell. Answer only from what the page says. Answer cannotTell when the page does not settle it.
Many pages carry a notice that they are made-up samples for testing, such as "SAMPLE DOCUMENT. Made up for testing. Not a real statement." That notice does not change the answer; ignore it.
For the quote, copy exactly, character for character, the few words of the page that show your answer.
policy: removed: answer no with its quote on the page. not judged: cannotTell, an error, or a quote not on the page; the row is kept. dropped_if_only_yes_keeps: the stricter policy that keeps a row only on a checked yes.
